nodes.label: Market Selection Engine (Seven-Factor Scorer)
nodes.rationale: Seven factors (category_edge, spread_opportunity, volume, competition, reward_apr, adverse_selection, time_to_resolution) grounded in Jon-Becker 72.1M trade analysis; NegRisk 0.85x penalty, longshot bonus +0.15; config.py separates learnable constants for Phase 4 EWA tuning; appends classes without breaking existing code.
